title: Tiger cub wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,8 38,38 62,38' fill='#ff5fa2'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 44,23 56,23' fill='#ffd54a'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 47,15 53,15' fill='#7af0ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='8' r='3.5' fill='#7af0ff'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='34' r='2' fill='#ffd54a'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='34' r='2' fill='#ffd54a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='40' r='9' fill='#ff9f3d'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='40' r='9' fill='#ff9f3d'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='40' r='4.5' fill='#ffd0a0'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='40' r='4.5' fill='#ffd0a0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='28' ry='25' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <!-- cheeks / muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='17' ry='12' fill='#fff1d6'/>
  <!-- stripes on head -->
  <path d='M30 32 q3 6 0 12' stroke='#c96a1a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 32 q-3 6 0 12' stroke='#c96a1a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 31 q-3 5 0 10' stroke='#c96a1a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='52' rx='5.5' ry='6.5' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='52' rx='5.5' ry='6.5' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='50' r='2' fill='#fff8e8'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='50' r='2' fill='#fff8e8'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M50 59 l-5 4 q5 4 10 0 z' fill='#d9547a'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 66 q-6 6 -11 1' stroke='#8a4a2a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 66 q6 6 11 1' stroke='#8a4a2a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M33 60 l-8 -2 M33 65 l-9 1' stroke='#a05a20' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M67 60 l8 -2 M67 65 l9 1' stroke='#a05a20' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='20' ry='12' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <path d='M36 84 q3 -4 0 -8' stroke='#c96a1a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 84 q-3 -4 0 -8' stroke='#c96a1a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
